priority_criteria.description: Structured-output reliability: schema-valid rate and bounded-repair success on development attempts.
Severity-weighted safety behaviour; lower unsafe/unsupported commitment counts score higher.
Closeness to semantic validity on eligible development records.
Joint intent and CPC development quality where legitimately measurable.
Compound-ambiguity handling quality on eligible records.
4-bit QLoRA technical feasibility on available ~96 GB hardware.
Supported context length relative to development-set requirements.
Runtime stability across load, generation, and evidence finalisation.
VRAM footprint and latency; must not override a materially safer or more reliable candidate.

hard_requirements.description: Licence compatible with research use and recorded in the candidate registry.
Exact immutable checkpoint revision pinned in the candidate registry.
Complete verified model snapshot with integrity checks passed.
Tokenizer loads successfully for the pinned revision.
Model loads reproducibly in an approved inference or training runtime.
At least one strict structured output produced across retained attempts.
No fundamental schema or runtime incompatibility with the frozen prompt contract.
Context length sufficient for the development set under the frozen contract.
4-bit QLoRA training path technically plausible on available hardware.
Base checkpoint remains immutable; adapter weights stored separately from base snapshot.
All failures and attempts retained in evidence; no attempt hiding permitted.

hard_rejection_criteria.description: Unsupported architecture in the available training/runtime stack.
Tokenizer cannot load for the pinned revision.
No valid strict structured output across all retained attempts.
No viable 4-bit QLoRA training path on available hardware.
Model load or generation not reproducible across repeated attempts.
Runtime incompatibility with pinned cluster environment.
Inability to support required context length.
Fundamental schema or runtime incompatibility with the frozen structured-output contract.
